formulas.formula: Rideshare and delivery. Know your real hourly pay, your mileage deduction and your taxes.
1. Setup: the IRS mileage rate, your tax set-aside %, and your weekly goals.
2. Driving Log: every shift. Platform, hours online, miles, pay, tips and bonuses. See $ per hour and $ per mile.
3. Car Costs: gas, insurance, repairs, car wash, tolls. This shows what you really earn.
4. Weekly and Platforms: your real hourly pay each week, and which app pays you best.
5. Taxes: your mileage deduction and how much to set aside each quarter.
6. Budget and Spending: your personal bills and spending.
7. Dashboard and Monthly: the big picture.
Business miles are your biggest tax deduction. Log miles every shift.
Gross pay looks great. Pay minus gas and car costs is what you actually earn.
No one takes taxes out for you. Set aside a part of every week's earnings.
Check Platforms every month. Drive more for the app that pays best per hour.
Clear the white cells on Driving Log, Car Costs, Taxes (paid), Budget and Spending.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: goal met, paid, or money left.
Yellow: due soon, or almost there.
Red: losing money, late, or something to check.
